dialogue.cheesedimension.rat_king.1: Welcome, traveller! A visitor in my castle at last. Few ever find their way here.
dialogue.cheesedimension.rat_king.2: I have ruled these cheese plains since before the first mouse squeaked. The sauce sea, the castle, the mice - all of it is mine.
dialogue.cheesedimension.rat_king.3: My mice love cheese, but beware of the mold. Whoever eats it will not forget it soon.
dialogue.cheesedimension.rat_king.4: Feed a mouse a piece of moldy cheese and it turns into a moldy mouse. They like to go out with a bang.
dialogue.cheesedimension.rat_king.5: The cheese sauce sea is warm and safe. You can swim in it, and even scoop up a bucket of it.
dialogue.cheesedimension.rat_king.6: This castle once rang with feasts. Now it is only me and my chests.
dialogue.cheesedimension.rat_king.7: Open the chests if you are hungry. Take what you need, but leave something for the next guest.
dialogue.cheesedimension.rat_king.8: Come back whenever you like, traveller. The doors of my castle are always open.
